import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns

def task_func(P, T):
    if not isinstance(P, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(T, np.ndarray):
        raise TypeError("Expected numpy matrix/array inputs.")

    P = np.asarray(P)
    T = np.asarray(T)

    if P.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("P must be a 2D matrix.")
    if T.ndim != 3:
        raise ValueError("T must be a 3D tensor.")
    if P.shape[1] != T.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError("Incompatible shapes: P.shape[1] must equal T.shape[0].")

    result = np.einsum("ij,jkl->ikl", P, T)
    result_2d = result.reshape(result.shape[0], -1)
    ax = sns.heatmap(result_2d)

    return result, ax
